overview: Beachcombers is a block of self-catering apartments at Watergate Bay, about 200 yards from the beach. It has one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, including duplexes and a sea-view penthouse, each with a full kitchen and a balcony or patio. Every apartment has a reserved parking space, and the building is open all year.
surfTripFit: A strong surf-trip fit: a short walk to Watergate Bay, lockers for boards and wetsuits, self-catering and year-round opening.
